approval_ref: The user asked to continue improving efficiency, accuracy and adaptability for RFI, submittal and email content.
notes: Use Python standard-library email parsing; execute no HTML and fetch no remote resource.
Inventory attachments without claiming they were analyzed; require separate upload for attachment analysis.
RFI questions cannot become material or QA candidates; workflow-source candidates remain conditional and human-reviewed.
title: RFI, submittal and EML evidence boundaries
objective: Parse EML headers and safe visible body text locally, preserve RFI question/response and Submittal status evidence boundaries, and prevent administrative or unapproved content from silently becoming current material or QA output.
